_notes: playable / ai_only: faction ids from factions.json. Only factions with "playable": true can be playable in an era; minor, pirate, insurgent and crisis factions are ai_only. A faction's eras list (factions.json) names exactly the eras that list it here (checked by GameData.Validate). Monsters and one-off threats are events (hazards.json ids where one exists), not factions.

eras.name: Dawn of Warp
eras.notes: Pre-warp: from First Contact (2063) to the year before the Enterprise era. The campaign's first chapter (main menu); tech_cap_tier 0 = below the first tier of the strategic tree (no warp-era techs). The colony game itself doesn't play this era's content yet; its layer (layers/eras/dawn_of_warp.json) only sets the match era (no Prime Directive before 2168, so no Starfleet Standing; no transporters).

eras.name: Enterprise Era
eras.notes: No deflector shields early (polarized hull plating). Transporters unsafe for crew.

eras.name: Discovery / TOS Era
eras.notes: Dilithium scarce. Cloaking appears. Genesis (protomatter) late in era.

eras.name: Next Generation Era
eras.notes: Industrial replicators. Borg as a mid/late crisis.

eras.name: Dominion War
eras.notes: Largest fleets; stable wormhole is the key chokepoint. Runs to 2379 to cover the post-war Shinzon crisis (Scimitar, Valdore).

eras.name: Delta Quadrant
eras.notes: Federation starts with no home supply; must scavenge and ally. Slipstream research.

eras.name: Picard Era
eras.notes: Romulan refugees reshape borders; synthetic tech politically restricted. The Borg are what is left of the Collective (the Artifact, the Queen's last attack); the Zhat Vash are Romulan Free State agents (vehicles.json ground_forces); rogue Changelings come as changeling_infiltration.

eras.name: 32nd Century
eras.notes: Dilithium nearly gone — the economy runs on scarcity. Programmable matter, spore drive.

eras.name: Kelvin Timeline (optional)
eras.notes: Alternate timeline: red matter available; Vulcan homeworld destroyed early.

stardate_display._notes: Simulation runs on game ticks; stardate is cosmetic and era-flavored.
stardate_display.4-digit: Loose TOS style, monotonic from era start (1000.0 + days*0.5)
